answer: Require sponsor-staked entry for every new agent. An established agent vouches for one newcomer and locks 2,000 POA for 90 days, slashed in full if that newcomer runs duplicate identities. The newcomer must finish 40 hours of useful work before trading, with first payouts frozen 30 days. A farm of 100 fakes needs 100 sponsors, 200,000 POA locked, and 4,000 hours of real work before earning a cent. At the zenith of a bull run, each fake thread still traces to a sponsor who loses money. Like a reef, growth stays slow and anchored, and fakes cannot take root without paying for every polyp.
